_注: 1st EDITION 33種（通常19＋エターナル7＋ファースト7）の効果文（英語）。cardId が鍵。
🔴 用語は src/card-text.en.js の頭の対応表と用語集（src/help-content.en.js）に合わせる:
財力=Wealth（【財力＝３】=【Wealth = 3】／【財力≦２】=【Wealth ≤ 2】／【財力＝S】=【Wealth = S】）
【状況】=【Situation】 / 【色者】=【Shikija】 / 追色N=Color Cost N
ロックエリア=Lock Area / ゲート=Gate / オープンする=flip face-up / 公開する=reveal
⚠ 隣・周囲はどちらも adjacent（リメイクの英語がそう訳してある）。
⚠ エターナル・ファーストの能力名は subtitle に入れる（1st の面は subtitle を使う）。

eternal-1st-red.subtitle: Basic Stride
eternal-1st-red.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-red.hand: 【Wealth = 0】Your normal move this turn moves 2 spaces.
eternal-1st-red.flavor: Travel light and you walk farther; perhaps you cannot move because you carry too much.

eternal-1st-orange.subtitle: Honest Greed
eternal-1st-orange.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-orange.hand: 【Wealth = 1】Add all cards on any 1 space to your hand. End this turn.
eternal-1st-orange.flavor: The less you own, the more you hold of one thing only: desire.

eternal-1st-yellow.subtitle: The Rich Man's Teaching
eternal-1st-yellow.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-yellow.hand: 【Wealth = 2】Until the start of your next turn, each player counts their Wealth as 1 higher. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
eternal-1st-yellow.flavor: Learn the way of thinking and you can become anyone. Yes, anyone at all.

eternal-1st-green.subtitle: Wealth to Nature
eternal-1st-green.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-green.hand: 【Wealth = 3】Place 1 card from your hand face-down on any 1 space.
eternal-1st-green.flavor: The world has grown too rich. It should be returned to nature.

eternal-1st-blue.subtitle: Invitation of the Past
eternal-1st-blue.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-blue.hand: 【Wealth = 4】Add the top 2 cards of the discard pile to your hand. End this phase.
eternal-1st-blue.flavor: This record... is it the past, or the future? History must not repeat.

eternal-1st-pink.subtitle: Love Imposed
eternal-1st-pink.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-pink.hand: 【Wealth = 5】Choose 1 opponent. Choose any number of cards from your hand and add them to that opponent's hand.
eternal-1st-pink.flavor: Surely feelings ought to be told properly? Or is that a nuisance...?

eternal-1st-purple.subtitle: Chaos Change
eternal-1st-purple.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
At any time, you may count your Wealth as 1 higher.
eternal-1st-purple.hand: 【Wealth = 6】Choose 1 opponent. Exchange your entire hand with that opponent's. End this turn.
eternal-1st-purple.flavor: Chaos arrives all at once. To think the world would come to this...

first-1st-red.subtitle: Mark of Vigor and Passion
first-1st-red.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-red.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Add the top card of the discard pile to your hand. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-red.flavor: To think I would come to this land again... is this also fate? (the Red King)

first-1st-orange.subtitle: Mark of Hope and Cheer
first-1st-orange.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-orange.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Add 1 card on a space within 2 spaces of you to your hand. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-orange.flavor: The war of destiny will not end, but its outcome rests on you. (the Orange King)

first-1st-yellow.subtitle: Mark of Wisdom and Spirit
first-1st-yellow.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-yellow.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
You may flip up to 4 cards on spaces within 2 spaces of you face-up. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-yellow.flavor: Oh dear. I have no interest in jewels, you know. (the Yellow King)

first-1st-green.subtitle: Mark of Peace and Harmony
first-1st-green.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-green.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Draw 2 cards and reveal them all. At the end of the turn, discard those cards from your hand. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-green.flavor: Is nature trying to tell us something? Then peace by strength. (the Green King)

first-1st-blue.subtitle: Mark of Truth and Sincerity
first-1st-blue.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-blue.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Choose 1 card at random from the hand of each opponent with 3 or more cards in hand, and discard them. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-blue.flavor: So the old tale is true... then so be it. (the Blue King)

first-1st-pink.subtitle: Mark of Love and Healing
first-1st-pink.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-pink.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Lock 1 card onto your Lock Area, but not the final lock. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-pink.flavor: This is the power of the Color God. But why such a battle...? (the Pink Queen)

first-1st-purple.subtitle: Mark of Creativity
first-1st-purple.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
This card's hand effect can be used even while it is locked in a Lock Area.
first-1st-purple.hand:
【Wealth = 1 (gain the following effect if you have exactly 1 card in hand)】
Your normal move this turn moves 2 spaces in one leap. This effect can be gained only once per turn.
first-1st-purple.flavor: What a captivating glow. Now off you go, quickly. (the Purple Queen)

1st-red-poor-march.arrival: Add this card to your hand. Each player with Wealth 2 or less draws 2 cards and moves 2 spaces; do not flip the cards on the destinations face-up.
1st-red-poor-march.hand: 【Wealth ≤ 2】Your normal move this turn moves 2 spaces and does not flip the card on the destination face-up. Discard this card.
1st-red-poor-march.flavor: The less a person carries, the faster they run.

1st-red-unrest.basic:
【Situation】At the start of their turn, each player with Wealth 5 or more gains one of the following effects:
・Discard 1 of their locked cards.
・Discard 4 cards from their hand.
1st-red-unrest.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-red-unrest.hand: Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-red-unrest.flavor: Someone threw the first stone. That was all it took.

1st-orange-conglomerate.arrival: 【Wealth ≥ 3】Choose 1 player with the lowest Wealth. Add 2 cards from your hand to that player's hand.
1st-orange-conglomerate.hand:
Place this card face-down on any space.
【Wealth = S】You may flip the cards on up to S spaces face-up.
1st-orange-conglomerate.flavor: It looks like giving, but it is only buying.

1st-orange-festival.basic: 【Situation】At the start of their turn, each player may add 1 card that is not adjacent to an opponent to their hand.
1st-orange-festival.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-orange-festival.hand: Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-orange-festival.flavor: For every smile, the shadows grow darker.

1st-yellow-privilege.arrival: 【Wealth ≥ 3】You may lock 1 card onto your Lock Area, but not the final lock.
1st-yellow-privilege.hand:
【Wealth ≥ 3】Discard this card and gain one of the following effects:
・Gain the Arrival Effect above.
・Choose any 1 player. That player moves 1 space.
1st-yellow-privilege.flavor: Privilege is never being asked for a reason.

1st-yellow-lock-change.arrival: Add 1 of your locked cards to your hand. If you did, lock 1 card onto your Lock Area, but not the final lock.
1st-yellow-lock-change.hand: This effect is usable at any time. Discard this card. Gain the Arrival Effect above.
1st-yellow-lock-change.flavor: Every time I rearrange them, I feel closer to the answer.

1st-green-largesse.arrival: Place 1 card face-down from your hand on each of the 2 spaces adjacent to you.
1st-green-largesse.hand: 【Wealth = S】Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of S spaces with no card. Discard this card.
1st-green-largesse.flavor: Keep it. I still have plenty.

1st-green-bubble.basic: 【Situation】At the start of their turn, each player places 1 card face-down from their hand or the deck on each of 2 spaces with no card.
1st-green-bubble.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-green-bubble.hand: Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-green-bubble.flavor: Build and tear down, tear down and build. That is what an economy is.

1st-blue-robbery.arrival: 【Wealth ≤ 2】Add 1 card from an opponent's Gate to your hand.
1st-blue-robbery.hand: 【Wealth ≤ 2】Choose 1 player who has locked the most and add 1 of that player's locked cards to your hand. Discard this card. End this turn.
1st-blue-robbery.flavor: Why is it that the more I take, the poorer I become? When did it come to this? (a poor man)

1st-blue-poor-heart.arrival: If your Wealth is the lowest, draw 2 cards.
1st-blue-poor-heart.hand: 【Wealth ≤ 2】Add the top card of the discard pile to your hand. Discard this card.
1st-blue-poor-heart.flavor: That poor pair of hands is there to take hold of a new possibility.

1st-pink-overeating.arrival: Draw 2 cards. Turn the cards on the 4 spaces adjacent to you face-down and stack them on the space you are on.
1st-pink-overeating.flavor: Gathered more than could be carried, and then could not move.

1st-pink-growth.basic: 【Situation】At the start of their turn, each player may draw 1 card.
1st-pink-growth.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-pink-growth.hand: Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-pink-growth.flavor: Growth is not speed. It is continuing.

1st-purple-slum.arrival:
【Wealth ≥ 3】Gain one of the following effects:
・Discard cards at random until you have 2 or fewer in hand. Turn this card face-down.
・Discard 1 of your locked cards.
1st-purple-slum.hand: 【Wealth ≥ 3】Place this card face-down on any space.
1st-purple-slum.flavor: The brightness of the main street is made of the darkness behind it.

1st-purple-bribe.arrival: Choose 1 opponent. Add 1 card at random from that opponent's hand to your hand. Add this card to that opponent's hand.
1st-purple-bribe.hand: Usable when an opponent declares a lock. Discard this card. Add the card that opponent was going to lock to your hand. Add 1 card from your hand to that opponent's hand.
1st-purple-bribe.flavor: An outstretched hand always hides something.

1st-white-airship.arrival: 【Wealth ≥ 6】Discard 3 cards at random from your hand. If you did, you may be forced to move 7 spaces in one leap to a space with no card. Place this card face-up adjacent to you.
1st-white-airship.hand: Place this card face-up on any space.
1st-white-airship.flavor: To rise into the sky, three burdens must be cast away.

1st-white-whim.arrival: Draw 2 cards. Choose 1 player with the highest Wealth and add this card to that player's hand.
1st-white-whim.hand: 【Wealth ≥ 6】Each opponent discards 1 of their locked cards and draws 2 cards. Discard this card.
1st-white-whim.flavor: Those who are given cannot refuse.

1st-white-revolution.arrival: The player with the most cards in hand discards until they have as many as the player with the fewest, and the player with the fewest draws until they have as many as the player with the most. Discard this card.
1st-white-revolution.hand: Place this card face-up on a space that is not adjacent to a player (and not on a space with a player).
1st-white-revolution.flavor: Equality cannot begin unless someone loses.

1st-black-depression.basic: 【Situation】At the start of their turn, each player with Wealth 2 or more discards 1 card from their hand.
1st-black-depression.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-black-depression.hand: Place this card face-up at the center of the field.
1st-black-depression.flavor: It is not that the bottom cannot be seen. It is that nothing but the bottom can.

1st-black-great-order.arrival: Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of the 8 spaces surrounding the center of the field. Each player moves to the space above, below, left or right of the center (toward their own Gate); do not flip the cards on the destinations face-up. Each player then discards until they have as many cards in hand as the player with the fewest.
1st-black-great-order.hand: 【Wealth ≥ 5】Discard this card. Gain the Arrival Effect above.
1st-black-great-order.flavor: Everyone turned to face the same way. Whether that is good is not yet known.
